description: This file is a shell script that defines a series of tests for Git's reflog expiration and pruning functionalities. It includes setup procedures, test cases for various scenarios such as reflog operations, expiration, conflicts, and error handling, along with checks for internal consistency using Git's fsck tool.

methods.name: check_have
methods.description: Checks that specified objects exist in Git object database.

methods.name: check_fsck
methods.description: Runs 'git fsck --full' and checks its output for errors or specific messages.

methods.name: corrupt
methods.description: Simulates corruption by moving a Git object file.

methods.name: recover
methods.description: Recovers a corrupted object by moving it back to the correct path.

methods.name: check_dont_have
methods.description: Verifies that certain objects do not exist in the object database.
